name: @raqs31/claude-wal-session-viewer
description: A local viewer for Claude Code sessions: lifecycle events recorded by the wal-hook plugin, and token usage and cost read from the transcripts.

scripts.test: vite build --logLevel warn && node --test scripts/*.test.ts web/src/lib/*.test.ts && bash plugins/wal-hook/hooks/wal-hook.test.sh
scripts.build:dist: rm -rf dist && vite build && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && cp scripts/pricing.json dist/scripts/ && mkdir -p dist/web && cp -r web/dist dist/web/
